downregulation of long-term neuronal synaptic plasticity
narrow: inhibition of long-term neuronal synaptic plasticity

definition: A process that decreases long-term neuronal synaptic plasticity, the ability of neuronal synapses to change long-term as circumstances require. Long-term neuronal synaptic plasticity generally involves increase or decrease in actual synapse numbers.
label: negative regulation of long-term neuronal synaptic plasticity
